# GiftPicker

> GiftPicker (giftpicker.io) is a free 30-second gift-recommendation quiz by Presently. Users answer five questions about the recipient (relationship and age, occasion, interests, vibe, budget) and receive ranked, personalized gift picks from a hand-curated catalog of more than 500 gifts from 300+ brands, with direct buy links to the brand's site or Amazon. No account required.

## What it does

- Five-question quiz: who the gift is for (partner, parent, grandparent, friend, sibling, coworker, mentor, or treat yourself) and their age (6 tiers: baby, little one, teenager, young adult, adult, senior), the occasion (11 options, see below), up to 3 interests, up to 2 vibes (skipped for Sympathy), and a budget slider.
- Occasions covered: Birthday, Anniversary, Holiday, Wedding, Just Because, New Baby, Housewarming, Appreciation, Thank You, New Job, Sympathy (only gifts hand-picked for someone grieving), or Other, which reveals a free-text field for a custom occasion.
- Interest categories: Apparel and Accessories, Cooking, Creativity, Experiences, Fitness, Food and Drinks, Gaming, Health and Wellness, Home and Decor, Learning, Music, Nature and Outdoors, Organization, Personalization, Pets, Rest and Relaxation, Seasonal Gifts, Self-Care and Beauty, Sustainability, Tech and Electronics, Toys and Games, Travel.
- Vibes: Fun, Practical, Sentimental, Luxurious.
- Every gift in the catalog is hand-curated by the GiftPicker team, then matched to the quiz answers by a weighted scoring algorithm (interests weighted heaviest, then relationship, then budget fit, age fit, and vibe, with occasion adjustments). Only strong matches are shown, scored 0-100.
- Results pages can be shared via URL; the link reproduces the same picks.
- Gifts are hand-curated from 300+ brands including Apple, Lululemon, Patagonia, Pottery Barn, Anthropologie, Peloton, Aesop, Le Creuset, Diptyque, Le Labo, Smeg, and Bose.

## Gift pages

Every gift has a permanent, indexable page at https://giftpicker.io/gift/{id} (more than 500 live pages, listed in the sitemap). Each page contains the gift's name and brand, a description, its price or price range, a product photo, a direct buy link (to the brand's site or Amazon, tagged as an affiliate link where applicable), and schema.org Product structured data (name, description, image, brand, and price where available).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://giftpicker.io/): product overview and quiz entry point.
- [Quiz](https://giftpicker.io/quiz): the five-question gift finder.
- [For brands](https://giftpicker.io/brands): how brands submit a product for free editorial review or request a sponsored placement. Sponsored gifts pass the same review, only appear in results they match, and are always labeled.
- [Sitemap](https://giftpicker.io/sitemap.xml): every indexable page, meaning the home page and every live gift page.

Note: /results pages are per-visitor quiz output and are not meant to be indexed or cited as a canonical source. Use the gift pages above instead.

## About

GiftPicker is built and curated by Presently. The catalog is maintained by hand, and every gift is a real product from a real brand. Feedback tools are built in (users can flag broken links, unavailable products, or bad matches, and request new gift categories).
